diagram_previews.alt: Equilateral triangle ABC with apex A at the top. The blue incircle with centre O has a radius to side AB labelled 20, and the small red circle with centre P sits between A and the incircle, touching sides AB and AC and the incircle, with radius labelled rho. A grey dashed line runs from A down through P and O to the base, and right-angle marks show the radii meeting AB.
